This '''ravine''' was cut into a high mesa on a remote [[Unidentified fenti bean colony|agricultural colony]]. After a series of disappearances around the ravine, the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] settlers believed it to be haunted. In fact, the ravine was inhabited by a [[Unidentified carnivorous plant|carnivorous plant]], which attacked those that entered its corridors. In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shalavaa]] slew the beast, after entering the ravine to investigate the disappearance of a [[Unidentified nerf herder|nerf herder]].
